description: This file defines a generic 32-bit message digest 'collector' for hash algorithms, including inline functions for updating and finalizing digest computations, and type definitions for block functions.

methods.name: crypto_md32_update
methods.description: Updates the digest state with new input data, processing complete blocks and handling partial blocks.

methods.name: crypto_md32_final
methods.description: Finalizes the digest computation by processing remaining data and appending length, preparing the final hash state.
